text: In a bizarre culinary trend that has left many scratching their heads, some individuals are reportedly pairing divorce papers with ketchup in a peculiar attempt to digest their emotional distress. This absurd practice, which has surfaced in social media discussions, involves literally consuming the legal documents that symbolize the end of a marriage, often served with the condiment to mask the 'paper' taste. Experts warn that not only is this act impractical, but it also highlights the unconventional ways people cope with heartbreak.
